name: Ripple
description: Concentric rings that swell outward from the centre, as a calm backdrop behind a heading or a call to action. Content goes in front of the rings.

children.description: Content shown in front of the rings, centred.

size.description: Diameter in pixels of the innermost ring.

color.description: Colour of the rings, any CSS colour. Defaults to the strong border colour.

isPaused.description: Stops the animation. Moving content that lasts more than five seconds should be stoppable.

className.description: Classes for the wrapper: size it and give it a background.

requirements: Decoration only: the animated layers are hidden from assistive technology and never take focus
Stands still for visitors who ask for less motion (prefers-reduced-motion), and the effect can also be shown still with the rdm-still class
The rings are low contrast by design and never carry meaning
Text placed over them keeps its own contrast against the page, not against the rings
Does not flash: nothing changes more than three times in a second (WCAG 2.3.1)
Optional: it is a separate component, so projects that do not add it carry none of its code
screenReader: Silent: only the content in front is read

use_when: Behind a hero heading or a sign-up block
An empty or waiting state that should feel calm
avoid_when: Small areas, where rings are clipped awkwardly
anti_patterns: Bright, high-contrast ring colours behind text
